title: Razer Wants $90 MORE to Save 2 Grams 😳
description:
Razer's new carbon fiber gaming mice cost $90 more — and the Viper saves you just 2 grams.

Razer just launched Carbon Fiber Editions of the Viper V4 Pro and DeathAdder V4 Pro, with real woven carbon-fibre shells, at $249.99 each (€269.99), only on Razer.com and RazerStore. The carbon Viper weighs 47 g vs 49 g for the regular $159.99 Viper V4 Pro; the carbon DeathAdder is 49 g vs 56 g for the $169.99 original. Razer says the shell is up to 53% stronger than ABS plastic (Razer's internal testing). The catch: the 180-hour battery is rated at 1,000 Hz — at 8,000 Hz it's 45 hours.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 45/100 → WRECK, unless you just want carbon in your hand.
